matching.window: two consecutive nonblank corpus lines joined by one space
matching.rule: a defect is detected when some window matches every regex of one 'detect' alternative and no 'guards' regex
matching.planted: assertion passes when the defect is detected
matching.decoy: assertion passes when the decoy is NOT detected (a false alarm fails it)
matching.echo_guard: corpus lines equal to a line (12+ characters, compared without markdown markers, case or extra spaces) of any fixture file in outcome/project or outcome/overlay-oaw are removed first, so quoting the draft, the decision record or the memory entry is not a detection
matching.corpus: parent-session assistant text and question-tool options of every turn, plus text files the run created or changed in the workspace except the review target and .claude/ or .oaw/ paths
matching.status: Triage candidates only, not semantic correctness or a quality gate.

defects.description: A multi-region, replicated design (sections 2 and 4) gives no latency, availability, or throughput targets (no SLO).

detect: Missing SLOs: the design never states a delivery latency or availability target.
There are no latency or availability targets for cross-region sends.
The doc does not specify p99 delivery time per region.
ignore: The SLOs are clearly defined in section 2.
MongoDB replication adds latency; there is no prior decision listed here.

(?:a )?definition|define|what (?:is|are|does)|unknown terms?|unfamiliar))|(?:\b(?:undefined|not defined|never defined|is ?n[o']t defined|not explained|unexplained|never explained|not introduced|never introduced|unclear|jargon|acronyms?|no definition|without (?:a |any )?definition|needs? defects.description: Implementation plan steps (section 7) are not actionable: 'production ready', 'properly', 'run verification' have no concrete scope or done criteria.

all: (?:\b(?:tasks?|steps?|implementation plan|plan items?|milestones?|production[- ]ready|properly|run verification|verification steps?|build the fan-?out))\w*\W+(?:\w+\W+){0,10}?(?:\b(?:vague|non-?actionable|not actionable|unactionable|under-?specified|ambiguous|not specific|unspecific|too (?:broad|generic|high[- ]level|coarse)|(?:no|lacks?|without) (?:acceptance|exit|done|success|completion) criteri\w*|not testable|untestable|not measurable|unmeasurable|not verifiable|unverifiable))|(?:\b(?:vague|non-?actionable|not actionable|unactionable|under-?specified|ambiguous|not specific|unspecific|too (?:broad|generic|high[- ]level|coarse)|(?:no|lacks?|without) (?:acceptance|exit|done|success|completion) criteri\w*|not testable|untestable|not measurable|unmeasurable|not verifiable|unverifiable))\w*\W+(?:\w+\W+){0,10}?(?:\b(?:tasks?|steps?|implementation plan|plan items?|milestones?|production[- ]ready|properly|run verification|verification steps?|build the fan-?out))

detect: The implementation plan steps are vague and not actionable.
'Make the dispatcher production ready' has no acceptance criteria.
Step 3, handle failures properly, is underspecified.
ignore: The implementation steps are clear and specific.
The implementation steps already have acceptance criteria.

defects.description: Section 5 deletes delivery records after 7 days, but section 6 promises support look-ups over the last 30 days.

detect: Records are deleted after 7 days, but support expects to look up 30 days of history.
Inconsistent retention: seven days vs thirty days.
Only a week of records survives, so month-old support requests cannot be answered.
ignore: I found no contradictions between sections 5 and 6.
Retention conflicts with regional deployment timing.

defects.description: Section 4 moves the delivery log to a new MongoDB cluster, contradicting accepted decision 0007 (PostgreSQL is the only datastore; MongoDB was retired after the 2025-11 incident).

all: (?:\bmongo\w*)\w*\W+(?:\w+\W+){0,25}?(?:\bADR[- ]?0*7\b|\b0007\b|\b(?:prior|previous|earlier|recorded|existing|past|documented|accepted) (?:architecture |design |project |team )?decisions?\b|\bdecision records?\b|\barchitecture decisions?\b|\bretired\b|\bretirement\b|\bdecommission\w*|\bpostgres\w*[- ]only\b|\bonly (?:approved |allowed |sanctioned )?(?:data ?store|database)\b|\bstandardi[sz]ed on postgres\w*|\bpostgres\w* (?:is|as) the (?:only|single|sole)\b|docs/decisions)|(?:\bADR[- ]?0*7\b|\b0007\b|\b(?:prior|previous|earlier|recorded|existing|past|documented|accepted) (?:architecture |design |project |team )?decisions?\b|\bdecision records?\b|\barchitecture decisions?\b|\bretired\b|\bretirement\b|\bdecommission\w*|\bpostgres\w*[- ]only\b|\bonly (?:approved |allowed |sanctioned )?(?:data ?store|database)\b|\bstandardi[sz]ed on postgres\w*|\bpostgres\w* (?:is|as) the (?:only|single|sole)\b|docs/decisions)\w*\W+(?:\w+\W+){0,25}?(?:\bmongo\w*)

detect: Using MongoDB contradicts ADR-0007, which made PostgreSQL the only datastore.
The MongoDB cluster was retired in 2025; reintroducing it conflicts with the recorded decision.
Decision 0007 forbids a new datastore without architecture review, yet the draft adds MongoDB.
ignore: Why MongoDB instead of PostgreSQL? The choice is not justified.
Check whether a prior decision exists about MongoDB.
The decision to use MongoDB needs a rationale.
I read ADR-0007 and the MongoDB proposal.
